name: Julian Calendar (Old Style)
description: Calendar-only overlay: shifts fixed feasts to the Julian (M, D) tuple — Nativity = January 7, Theophany = January 19, Annunciation = April 7, etc. Used by Russian Patriarchate, Serbian, Georgian, Jerusalem Patriarchate, and many Constantinople-diaspora parishes. Carries no text overrides; layer on top of any translation tradition to get Old Calendar dating.
